Onderzoek/forecast signaleert één duidel: Research/forecast identifies one clear problem: many SMEs struggle to connect their accounting software to new mobile payment solutions. This article explains how to connect those internal and external changes in practice with strategy, finance, processes, people and risks — and provides a concrete checklist with responsibilities and measurable outcomes.
Extern signaal: opkomende mobiele betaal: External signal: emerging mobile payment apps and new payment flows create more real-time transactions and different data formats.
Intern gevolg: bestaande bankfeeds en ha: Internal consequence: existing bank feeds and manual reconciliation processes create delays, errors and higher staffing costs.
Beperking van het bewijs: dit is een ver: Evidence limitation: this is an exploratory observation based on research data; there is no broad, independent measure showing that all SMEs are affected.
Signaal: mobiel betalingsverkeer neemt t: Signal: mobile payments are growing or changing format.
Context: jouw huidige boekhoudflow, bank: Context: your current accounting workflow, bank feeds and payment providers (who has access to data, in what format and how often).
Gevolg: hogere afstemmingstijd tussen on: Consequence: more time spent reconciling incoming payments with outstanding invoices; risk of missing cash-position signals.
Beslissing: kies tussen drie integratie-: Decision: choose between three integration routes (see the step-by-step plan), based on cost, time to value and risk.
Actie: implementeer een pilot (API/webho: Action: implement a pilot (API/webhook/middleware) with an assigned owner and defined metrics.
Resultaat: kortere reconciliatietijd, la: Outcome: shorter reconciliation times, fewer manual interventions and faster cash visibility.
Leren: meet de pilot, stel procesregels: Learning: measure the pilot, adjust process rules and revise or scale up based on the KPIs.

Stap 4: selecteer stakeholders en eigena: Step 4: select stakeholders and an owner

Stap 1 — Baseline meten (wat meet je eer: Step 1 — Measure the baseline (what should you measure first?)
Meetpunt: huidige tijd die boekhouding/f: Metric: current time spent by accounting/finance on reconciliation per week (hours).
Meetpunt: aantal betalingstransacties pe: Metric: number of payment transactions per month that must be matched to invoices manually.
Meetpunt: aantal onverklaarde of opensta: Metric: number of unexplained or outstanding payments after 7 days.
Stap 2 — Beschrijf de gewenste datastrom: Step 2 — Describe the desired data flows
Beschrijf welk signaal je nodig hebt van: Describe which signal you need from the payment app (payment received, status, payment reference, payment method, fees).
Bepaal welk doel je wilt bereiken in Twi: Determine what you want to achieve in Twinfield or your accounting system (automatic matching, booking fees, instant cash-position updates).
Stap 3 — Kies je integratie-architectuur: Step 3 — Choose your integration architecture (pros and cons)
Directe API-koppeling (wanneer beschikba: Direct API connection (where available): lowest latency, but requires development capacity and data-quality agreements.
Middleware/platforms (connector tussen b: Middleware/platforms (connector between payment app and Twinfield): faster to implement, higher cost per transaction, less custom development.
Bank-/payment-batchfeeds + automatische: Bank/payment batch feeds plus automatic matching in Twinfield: least disruptive, but may retain delays and errors.
Strategisch eigenaar: directeur / CFO (b: Strategic owner: managing director / CFO (decides on budget and risk acceptance).
Operationele eigenaar: hoofd financiën o: Operational owner: head of finance or process owner (responsible for acceptance criteria and KPIs).
Technische eigenaar: IT/leverancier of e: Technical owner: IT/vendor or external integrator (builds and maintains the connection).
Stap 5 — Risico’s & compliance (wat je m: Step 5 — Risks and compliance (what you need to arrange)
Controleer privacy en toestemming voor b: Check privacy and consent for payments (PSD2, GDPR where applicable).
Maak afspraken over foutafhandeling: wan: Agree on error handling: what happens when a webhook fails?
Beveiliging: API-keys, OAuth en logging: Security: API keys, OAuth and audit logging.
Stap 6 — Pilot: scope en succescriteria: Step 6 — Pilot: scope and success criteria
Scope voorbeeld: koppel één betaalkanaal: Example scope: connect one payment channel with all incoming payment transactions for one product line or sales channel.
Succescriteria (meetbaar): daling van ha: Measurable success criteria: fewer hours spent on manual reconciliation; percentage of automatic matches; no unauthorised transactions.
Tijdsbox: 4–8 weken uitvoering, 2 weken: Time box: 4–8 weeks of implementation, followed by a 2-week measurement period after go-live.
Meet de KPI’s ten opzichte van de baseli: Measure the KPIs against the baseline.
Beslis: opschalen naar andere betaalkana: Decide whether to expand to other payment channels, scale the technology (more API endpoints), or roll back.
Leg leerpunten vast en pas procesdocumen: Record lessons learned and update the process documentation.
Beslissing: start een pilot voor automat: Decision: start a pilot for automatic matching via middleware with one mobile payment provider.
Eigenaar: operationeel verantwoordelijk: Owner: operational responsibility rests with the head of finance.
Actie: externe integrator bouwt connecto: Action: an external integrator builds the connector; IT handles security and logging.
Meetpunt: reduceer handmatige matching-u: Metric: reduce weekly manual matching hours (compared with baseline) and increase automatic matches to the agreed target within 8 weeks.
Leren: documenteer welke fouttypen terug: Learning: document recurring error types and which data fields the payment provider needs to improve.
Hypothese: als we betalingswebhooks real: Hypothesis: if we connect payment webhooks to the accounting system in real time, the time the finance team spends on reconciliation will be halved (test this through a pilot).
Opmerking: dit is een testbare hypothese: Note: this is a testable hypothesis based on market observations, not a guaranteed result.
Beperking: de onderliggende observatie i: Limitation: the underlying observation is exploratory; implementations vary considerably by software stack, bank and payment provider.
Eerlijk alternatief: niets doen en blijv: Honest alternative: do nothing and continue relying on existing batch processes — this maintains the status quo but avoids extra integration costs and risks in the short term.
Begin klein: test met één betaalkanaal e: Start small: test with one payment channel and one product line.
Dwing referentieveldnormen af (ordernumm: Enforce reference-field standards (order number or invoice number) in the payment flow.
Automatiseer alerts bij mismatches zodat: Automate alerts for mismatches so the team can intervene quickly.
Houd eindgebruiker en administratie op d: Keep end users and the administration team informed about process changes.
Gebruik bereid niet als papieren vinkje:: Do not use 'prepare' as a box-ticking exercise: assess the actual situation, test the criteria and record the chosen action.
Vier vaste controlepunten voor bereid: f: Four fixed checkpoints for preparation: facts, agreements, risk and evidence. This keeps the assessment reproducible.
Plan binnen 7 werkdagen een 2‑uur audit/: Within 7 working days, schedule a 2-hour audit/workshop with the CFO, head of finance and IT — use the 7-step checklist above as the agenda. Then define a 4–8-week pilot with a clear owner and metrics.
